# AgentCall API - LLM Reference Guide

> Give your AI agent a phone.

AgentCall enables autonomous AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, LangChain, n8n, Make) to trigger phone calls with a human-in-the-loop browser dialer.

## Base URL
https://agentcall.org/api/v1

## Authentication
Use Bearer token in the Authorization header:
`Authorization: Bearer rg_live_...` or `Authorization: Bearer rg_test_...`

Test keys (`rg_test_`) simulate calls safely without charging or dialing out.

## Key Endpoints
1. `POST /v1/calls`: Create a call task.
   - Body: `{"to": "+14155552671", "goal": "Pitch service", "script": "Hello...", "consent_attestation": true}`
2. `GET /v1/calls/:id`: Check call status (`awaiting_human`, `ringing`, `in_progress`, `completed`).
3. `POST /v1/calls/:id/cancel`: Cancel an unclaimed call.
4. `GET /v1/balance`: Check prepaid balance.
5. `GET /v1/rates?to=+14155552671`: Check rate estimate.
6. `POST /v1/webhooks`: Register a webhook URL for call events.

## Safety & Rules
- `consent_attestation: true` is strictly required on every call.
- Emergency numbers (911, 112) and premium-rate prefixes (1-900) are blocked globally.
- Prepaid credit holds are placed atomically upon call creation.
